simple.meaning: יַלְדוּת (yaldûwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “boyhood (or girlhood ).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יַלְדוּת (H3208) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 110:3, with occurrences in Psalms, Ecclesiastes.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יַלְדוּת (H3208) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יַלְדוּת (H3208) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יַלְדוּת (yaldûwth) / H3208 is traced through Psalms 110:3, Ecclesiastes 11:9, Ecclesiastes 11:10 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
